records.text: Candace Owens said Nicola Peltz went through three wedding contracts, one of which led to reciprocal lawsuits between her father and the contractor.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: She's been involved in a lot of legal spats pertaining to her. ... To her wedding, she went through three different wedding contracts, ... one of which her father sued and they sued back and said, your daughter is awful.

verification.notes: Court reporting confirms Nelson Peltz sued wedding planners and the planners countersued. However, later reporting says the couple used four wedding planners, not three. The reciprocal-litigation portion is supported, while the count is contradicted.
